items.period: Shang period style; modern drawing based on cited historical character references, without a specific artifact/date identified in the page description
items.caption: This oracle-script-style form of 不 has a tall central stroke and two sweeping sides. 不 is reported as a negative particle in oracle-bone inscriptions, though its original referent remains disputed.
items.alt: A black oracle-script-style glyph with a tall central stroke and two curved strokes descending to either side.
items.selection_reason: The visible form is legible as an oracle-style rendering of 不 and illustrates the early script tradition associated with its reported use as a negative particle. The plant-root, flower-calyx, and bird explanations remain competing interpretations.
items.rights: Wikimedia Commons page states public domain for the modern vector representation.

items.period: Shuowen seal-script style; modern drawing, not a dated ancient artifact image
items.tradition: Seal script as transmitted in the Shuowen tradition
items.caption: This Shuowen seal-script-style form of 不 has a horizontal top and several descending strokes. Shuowen's bird-flying-upward explanation is a historical interpretation, not proof of the graph's original referent.
items.alt: A black seal-script-style glyph with a horizontal top and several strokes descending below it.
items.selection_reason: Its visible seal-style form gives a useful comparison with the oracle-style rendering. It also helps distinguish the transmitted Shuowen explanation from the unresolved debate over the graph's origin.
items.rights: Wikimedia Commons page states public domain for the modern vector representation.

limitations.text: Both images are modern redrawings in historical script styles, not photographs or facsimiles of ancient inscriptions. Their appearance does not establish the graph's original referent or a sequence of graphic changes.

The graph's original referent remains unresolved: sources discuss root or germ, flower calyx, and Shuowen's bird account. Early use as a negative particle is reported, but a specific inscription date and a demonstrated path from the proposed referent to negation are not established.
